# FreeRTOS Kernel

This directory contains the source files used by the STM32H743 FreeRTOS example.
They are from FreeRTOS-Kernel 11.1.0, commit
`dbf70559b27d39c1fdb68dfb9a32140b6a6777a0` (2024-04-22).

The upstream MIT license is in `LICENSE.md`. Only the task, list, queue,
heap_4, and GCC Cortex-M7 r0p1 port files needed by this example are included.
